reservierungen_settings.title: Reservations
reservierungen_settings.info_duration: Defines how long a table is considered occupied from the start of the reservation. This value is used in the widget to calculate free time slots, and in the room detail to automatically switch the status to "Time expired". Recommended: 90–120 minutes for most restaurants.
reservierungen_settings.info_auto_expire: When active, the status of a checked-in guest automatically switches to "Time expired" once the default reservation duration has elapsed. The heartbeat runs every minute — so the service team can immediately see where to follow up. When disabled, the status must be manually set to "Completed".
reservierungen_settings.info_cleanup: The cleanup time is a buffer after each reservation at the same table — for example for setting the table or cleaning. In the widget, this period is taken into account when calculating slots, so guests cannot book the table immediately after a previous booking. Recommended: 15–20 minutes.
reservierungen_settings.info_drinks: After a guest checks in, a timer starts automatically. After the set time, a hint icon appears in the room detail next to the relevant table — a signal for the service team to take the drinks order. The timer restarts once the hint has been confirmed.
reservierungen_settings.info_vip: Defines how many reservations a guest needs to be classified as VIP in the guest database. VIP guests are highlighted specially during check-in and receive a special label in the guest list. Guests with at least 60% of the VIP threshold are marked as regulars.
